summary.value: The public GitHub organization profile and its short project index.
The public Merely company site and repository-family map.
An embeddable Rust web engine with modular static, interactive, scripted, and full-web profiles.
The graph-first library for addressable content, spatial arrangement, local memory, and trusted exchange.
Transport and device management for the Merely stack, including native peer carriers, conversations, radio protocols, and operator applications.
A Vello and wgpu realization engine for Genet paint lists and other retained scenes.
Spec-faithful Rust implementations of Misfin, Spartan, Nex, Guppy, and adjacent small-web protocols.
A pure-Rust WavPack v5 codec for lossless audio.
A library for importing native GPU textures into wgpu textures.
A library for embedding system webviews into wgpu textures.
A library for embedding Chromium Embedded Framework surfaces into wgpu textures.
A graph-shaped browser host for relating, curating, and cooperatively browsing the web.
A files-in-place, local-first Djot editor that keeps document authority and contributes the same retained surface to hosts such as Turnstone.
An open-source practice toolkit for musicians.

One simulated world played three ways: the Isocosm simulator and the games over it, Isocosm: VTT (a pixel-art isometric virtual tabletop with peer-to-peer play), Isocosm: Mesocosm (an ecological roguelike of lineages) and Isocosm: Eponym (a second-person action RPG). The tabletop crates are MIT OR Apache-2.0; the simulator, Mesocosm, Eponym and the shared wing crates are MPL-2.0.
A data-oriented JavaScript engine for Genet, maintained as a substantial Nova fork.
A local-first Tarot, dice, and astrology journal built on Graphshell, with replayable readings and explicit sync consent.
A pure-Rust IconVG encoder and decoder that turns compact vector graphics into paths and fills for a host renderer.
A dependency-free prosody engine for syllabification, syllable weight, verse meter, rhyme, and other sound relationships.
A dependency-free speech codec for constrained links, with framed IMA ADPCM and low-bitrate LPC voice clips.
A celestial calculation engine for positions and events, with explicit time scales, observer frames, and reproducible model provenance.
